elements.requirement: Subject to section 140B, proceedings on a complaint within section 120 may not be brought after the end of the period of 3 months starting with the date of the act to which the complaint relates, or such other period as the employment tribunal thinks just and equitable.
elements.quote: Subject to section 140B proceedings on a complaint within section 120 may not be brought after the end of— (a) the period of 3 months starting with the date of the act to which the complaint relates, or (b) such other period as the employment tribunal thinks just and equitable.

elements.requirement: Proceedings brought in reliance on section 121(1) may not be brought after the end of the period of 6 months starting with the date of the act to which the proceedings relate, or such other period as the employment tribunal thinks just and equitable.
elements.quote: Proceedings may not be brought in reliance on section 121(1) after the end of— (a) the period of 6 months starting with the date of the act to which the proceedings relate, or (b) such other period as the employment tribunal thinks just and equitable.

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 123, conduct extending over a period is to be treated as done at the end of that period.
elements.quote: conduct extending over a period is to be treated as done at the end of the period

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 123, a failure to do something is to be treated as occurring when the person in question decided on it.
elements.quote: failure to do something is to be treated as occurring when the person in question decided on it

elements.requirement: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, a person (P) is to be taken to decide on a failure to do something when P does an act inconsistent with doing it.
elements.quote: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, a person (P) is to be taken to decide on failure to do something— (a) when P does an act inconsistent with doing it

elements.requirement: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, if a person (P) does no act inconsistent with doing something, P is to be taken to decide on a failure to do it on the expiry of the period in which P might reasonably have been expected to do it.
elements.quote: if P does no inconsistent act, on the expiry of the period in which P might reasonably have been expected to do it
